formationSize.note: Neolithic war band of a few hundred. Educated guess.
Early Bronze Age city-state host divided into contingents of ~1,000. Educated guess.
New Kingdom Egyptian army fought at Kadesh in divisions (Amun, Ra, Ptah, Seth) of ~5,000 by modern estimates; Wikipedia gives 2,000-2,500 chariots per side.
Medieval 'battle' (division of a field army) of a few thousand. Educated guess.
Tercio: some derive the name from the 3,000 men of the first units; by 1600 tercios were often under strength (1,500-2,500, estimate).
Napoleonic division ~6,000-10,000; corps 20,000-30,000 (high). Educated guess on the typical manoeuvre unit.
Divisions of 1914-18: 1917 US division 28,061 (high); European divisions c.15,000-17,500 (estimate).
Divisions mostly 10,000-15,000 soldiers; Soviet rifle divisions often ~7,000-9,000 in practice (estimate).
Brigade combat teams ~4,500 are the main manoeuvre unit; Russian BTG 600-800 (low); divisions persist (high).
